[[File:Terazod1.jpg|thumb|left|A submerged terazod foraging for food.]]'''Terazods''' were large, friendly, semiaquatic [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] native to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They grazed along swamp bottoms and slept upon moist sandbanks.<ref name=":0">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>

The terazod, the [[Falumpaset/Legends|falumpaset]], and the [[Fambaa/Legends|fambaa]] represented three different within the [[Gungan Swamp]]s: they were three plant-eaters that existed in the same territory but had different feeding strategies. In the case of the terazod, it floated and snorkeled when feeding on underwater plant life.<ref name=":0" />
